basic_info.description: Step into Bernal Heights Living! This semi-detached Mid-Century single-family home sits just one block from vibrant Cortland Avenue, where neighborhood charm meets city convenience. The sunlit main level offers a welcoming living room with picture windows, gleaming hardwood floors, two spacious bedrooms, an updated bathroom, and a thoughtfully refreshed kitchen with a cheerful breakfast nook. Downstairs, you'll find a versatile bonus space with kitchenette and full bathroom, perfect for guests, a home office or creative use. Out back, relax on a generous patio shaded by a magnificent avocado tree, surrounded by a garden space brimming with potential. Additional highlights include a one-car garage with laundry and abundant storage. With cafes, shops, Mini Prentiss Park and easy freeway access at your doorstep, this home blends comfort, flexibility and a prime Bernal Heights location. Here, you're not just buying a home, you're becoming part of the neighborhood.
